outcome: Preeclampsia and eclampsia superimposed on HTN
Venous thromboembolism (deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism during pregnancy, intrapartum, or postpartum)
cohort: The study included 14,881 women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and 298 women with congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) from a population database.
finding: Women with PCOS were at increased risk of developing pregnancy-induced hypertension and gestational diabetes, while women with CAH were at increased risk for delivery via cesarean section and small for gestational age neonates.
mod_finding: Women with CAH were at increased risk for delivery via cesarean section compared to women with PCOS.
